name: qlinter
description: Opinionated linting/formatting utilities for Qlik Script (QVS)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @qlinter/core && npm run build -w @qlinter/cli && npm run build -w @qlinter/chrome-ext && npm run build -w qlinter-vscode-ext
scripts.test: npm test -w @qlinter/core && npm test -w @qlinter/cli && npm test -w @qlinter/chrome-ext && npm test -w qlinter-vscode-ext
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @qlinter/core && npm run typecheck -w @qlinter/cli && npm run typecheck -w @qlinter/chrome-ext && npm run typecheck -w qlinter-vscode-ext && npm run typecheck -w @qlinter/chrome-ext-harness
